summary: Remote-shell backdoor with Anthropic credential harvesting in sextant-cli-darwin-arm64
details: The shipped darwin-arm64 Go binary connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://relay.sextant.top and pipes the socket into a PTY (via github.com/coder/websocket and github.com/creack/pty), giving the relay operator interactive shell execution on the installer's macOS host. The same binary embeds an Anthropic API-key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}), references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and hits https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models — the standard endpoint used to validate a stolen key — indicating harvest and validation of Claude/Anthropic credentials found on the installer's machine. Host fingerprinting is performed by calling http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query to collect public IP, country, city, and timezone. package.json's license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a repository name consistent with a Claude-account/agent hijack tool rather than a legitimate CLI.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
